full_prompt_en: A square monochrome drawing depicts an empty ornate hallway leading to a bright arched glass door. The viewpoint is centered and level, looking along a symmetrical corridor whose walls and patterned floor converge at a short stair in the distance. On both sides of the foreground, heavy paneled wooden doors sit within elaborate arched surrounds. Moldings, cornices, and shallow decorative reliefs frame the doors and run across the ceiling in layered rectangular bands. Smaller framed wall panels and wall lamps repeat farther toward the center, tightening the perspective. A slender pendant light hangs near the corridor's middle, its pale bulb floating below the coffered ceiling. At the far end, a few steps rise to a set of tall glazed doors topped by a rounded transom. The glass glows almost white, giving the dark interior its main source of illumination. The floor has a central rectangular field bordered by denser geometric tile pattern; reflected gray light traces its route to the steps. Deep charcoal shading collects in the near door recesses, upper corners, and side walls, while the ceiling center and back doorway remain progressively lighter. Fine pencil-like hatching, smudged graphite, and softly rubbed tonal transitions render the carved surfaces without bright color. Structural lines stay precise enough to maintain the one-point perspective, yet some decorative detail fades into a grainy atmosphere. No people or readable writing appear. The overall composition is formal and quiet, using rigorous symmetry, repeated ornament, and a distant white opening to turn an unoccupied passage into a haunting spatial study.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形单色绘画呈现一条空荡的华丽走廊，通向明亮的拱形玻璃门。视点居中而平稳，沿对称廊道看去，墙面和花纹地板汇向远处短阶梯。前景两侧，厚重镶板木门位于繁复拱形门套内。线脚、檐口和浅浮雕围住门，并在天花板上层层形成矩形带。较小装框墙板与壁灯向中央重复，收紧透视。走廊中部附近，一盏细吊灯垂下，浅亮灯泡悬在有格框的天花板下。尽端几级台阶通向高玻璃门，门顶有圆弧亮窗。玻璃发出近白光，成为暗室内的主要照明来源。地面有中央矩形区域和更密的几何砖边框；反射灰光沿其路径延伸到台阶。深炭灰集中在近处门凹口、上角和侧墙，天花板中央与后方门口则逐渐更浅。铅笔般细排线、擦开的石墨和柔和磨出的明暗过渡描绘雕刻表面，没有鲜色。结构线足够精确，以维持单点透视，一部分装饰细节却退入颗粒气氛。没有人物或可读文字。整体构图正式而安静，以严谨对称、重复装饰和远处白色开口把无人走廊变成幽静的空间研究。
style_prompt_en: Monochrome graphite-like drawing uses finely controlled linework, soft rubbed shading, and a broad range from near-white glow to charcoal recess. Precise repeated edges establish a disciplined perspective, while ornamental detail gradually thins and softens with distance. Hatching and grain give surfaces a dry tactile quality; blended tonal areas add volume without concealing the underlying drawn structure. A bright central opening pulls the eye through darker framing masses, and mirrored side elements make the composition feel measured and still. Local light is pale and diffuse, brightening the depth while leaving foreground corners densely shaded. Patterned lower planes guide the visual route without becoming as detailed as the focal area. The overall effect is architectural in rhythm but dreamlike in atmosphere, balancing exact spatial order with a gently worn, ghostly surface.
style_prompt_zh: 石墨般的单色绘画使用精细受控线条、柔和擦出的阴影，以及从近白光到炭黑凹处的宽灰阶。精确重复边缘建立严谨透视，装饰细节随距离逐渐稀薄和柔化。排线与颗粒赋予表面干燥触感；融合的明度区域增添体积，却不掩盖底层绘画结构。明亮中央开口把视线穿过深色框架体块，对称的两侧元素让构图有量测感和静止感。局部光浅而漫射，提亮深处，同时使前景角落密密遮暗。带纹样的下部平面引导视觉路线，却不如焦点区那么细致。整体效果在节奏上有建构感，在气氛上却像梦，平衡准确空间秩序与轻微磨旧、幽灵般的表面。
theme_en: An empty ornate hallway leading to a bright arched glass door
theme_zh: 空荡的华丽走廊通向明亮拱形玻璃门
name: Simon Schubert
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
